question: An FIR under s.318(4) BNS arises from a failed commercial supply contract. On what grounds can the High Court quash it under s.528 BNSS, and what are the leading authorities?
Is an accused entitled to default bail under s.187 BNSS if the charge-sheet is filed without the FSL report? Explain with authorities.
Can police arrest without first issuing a notice under s.35(3) BNSS for an offence punishable with up to seven years? What are the consequences of non-compliance?
An offence was committed in May 2024 but the FIR was registered in August 2024. Which procedural code governs the investigation and trial, and why?
What are the requirements for admissibility of WhatsApp chats as electronic evidence under s.63 BSA, and is the certificate mandatory?
The s.138 NI Act demand notice was returned 'unclaimed'. From when does the 15-day period run, and when must the complaint be filed?
Can a director who resigned before the cheque was dishonoured be prosecuted under s.141 NI Act? What must the complaint aver?
Is pre-institution mediation under s.12A of the Commercial Courts Act mandatory when the plaintiff seeks urgent interim relief? What is the consequence of skipping it?
Can a written statement in a commercial suit be taken on record after 120 days from service of summons?
What is the limitation for a suit for specific performance where no date for performance was fixed, and when does time start running?
Can an unstamped arbitration agreement be acted upon at the stage of appointment of an arbitrator under s.11 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act?
What does 'patent illegality appearing on the face of the award' mean under s.34(2A), and does it apply to international commercial arbitrations seated in India?
When will a High Court entertain a writ petition under Article 226 despite an alternative statutory remedy being available?
Is a private unaided school amenable to writ jurisdiction in a service dispute with a teacher?
Can a financial creditor file under s.7 IBC on the basis of a default recorded in balance sheets, and does acknowledgment in balance sheets extend limitation?
Is a non-compete clause in a share purchase agreement binding on a selling shareholder under s.27 of the Indian Contract Act?
Can the six-month cooling-off period under s.13B(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act be waived, and on what conditions?
What must a wife show to claim interim maintenance under s.144 BNSS, and what disclosure do courts require from both parties?
Is an unregistered agreement to sell admissible to prove part performance under s.53A of the Transfer of Property Act?
Can a home buyer approach the consumer commission instead of RERA for delayed possession, and which forum has pecuniary jurisdiction for a ₹1.2 crore flat?
What is the limitation for a GST first appeal under s.107 of the CGST Act, and can the appellate authority condone delay beyond the extra one month?
After the Labour Codes, does an IT company with 180 employees need government permission to retrench 40 engineers? What compensation and notice are payable?
How does the uniform definition of 'wages' under the Labour Codes affect gratuity and PF contributions for an employee whose basic pay is 35% of CTC?
Is a fixed-term employee who worked 18 months entitled to gratuity under the Code on Social Security? How is it calculated?
What is the procedure and timeline for an Internal Committee inquiry under the POSH Act, and can the complainant and respondent be represented by lawyers?
